description: Locale configuration for the Breton language ('br') in Moment.js, including functions for relative time, mutations, and locale-specific date formats.

methods.name: relativeTimeWithMutation
methods.description: Generates relative time strings with mutation based on number and key.

methods.name: specialMutationForYears
methods.description: Returns the correct form of 'year' in Breton based on the number.

methods.name: lastNumber
methods.description: Recursively extracts the last digit of a number.

methods.name: mutation
methods.description: Applies soft mutation to a text if the number is 2.

methods.name: softMutation
methods.description: Performs soft mutation on the first character of a string based on a mutation table.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Returns the ordinal suffix for a given number in Breton.
